data.identity_rule: Exact count sample ID corresponds to metadata file value with suffix fb removed; metadata row order is not count-column order.
data.full_universe_policy: Fit all14599 supplied genes together. Do not normalize or fit a selected reporting panel. Untested/null rows remain in the universe.

source_provenance.scope: Unmodified historical observations. No laboratory procedure or new biological observation; no causal or mechanistic interpretation.

data.method_scope: Replicated bulk-count negative-binomial model, unshrunk signed tested/reference log2FC, two-sided Wald H0=0. No count replacement or independent filtering. Cook p filtering enabled. One CPU; no approximate mean-test substitute.
data.decision_policy: BH on every testable model gene. Reporting panel chosen by this audit, not claimed historically preregistered. Select panel genes with adjusted_p<=q_limit AND abs(unshrunk point log2FC)>=margin. This is a zero-null association plus point-estimate screen, not a formal minimum-effect hypothesis test.

provenance.kind: Public historical records and/or explicitly disclosed derived audit inputs; source-specific provenance is in the study record. Controlled numerical teaching fixtures make no experimental observation claim.
